does: Prepares the AI helpers for one decision request: gathers the level's characters and items with their transforms and the on-damage spells of items into the helper's working state.

evidence.says: queries over ls::TransformComponent, ls::LevelComponent, esv::Item and esv::spell::OnDamageSpellsComponent filling the helper's arrays

A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on, from 2 places, the request function at +0x31071A0 and one at +0x3615CA0, each paired with UnprepareRequest at the same count (308 and 14)
